summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K disclosing a May 26, 2026 Nasdaq Hearings Panel notice confirming the company regained compliance with the Bid Price Rule (minimum $1.00 closing bid for 30 consecutive days). The Panel granted an extension to May 18, 2026 to demonstrate compliance; upon satisfaction, it imposed a Mandatory Panel Monitor until May 26, 2027. If the bid price again falls below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days during monitoring, Nasdaq will issue a delisting determination without the usual 180-day grace period. The company may request a hearing to stay delisting. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation.
